# hsnlabs

> Enterprise agentic engineering boutique solving why enterprise AI agents fail in production. We handle the complete Agentic Development Life Cycle (ADLC): executable business ontologies, zero-trust infrastructure, stateful orchestration, and continuous evaluation in production. We structure and execute enterprise agentic roadmaps across both Headless Agents (back-office process automation, BPO replacement, and internal data workflows) and Surface Agents (front-office real-time voice and text interfaces for end customers). The primary site at root (`/`) is in Brazilian Portuguese (`pt-BR`), with the full English mirror under `/en/`.

## Canonical Positioning & Value Proposition
- [Overview (PT-BR)](https://hsnlabs.ai/): Adoção de Engenharia Agentica. Implementamos Headless Agents para backoffice, dados e automação interna e Surface Agents para frontoffice em voz e texto com o cliente sobre sistemas legados.
- [Overview (EN)](https://hsnlabs.ai/en/): Agentic Engineering Adoption. We implement Headless Agents for back-office data and internal automation and Surface Agents for front-office voice and text interfaces over legacy systems.
- [Markdown Mirror (PT-BR)](https://hsnlabs.ai/index.md): Machine-readable Markdown overview in Brazilian Portuguese.
- [Markdown Mirror (EN)](https://hsnlabs.ai/en/index.md): Machine-readable Markdown overview in English.

## Entry Engagement: Agentic Bootcamp™
- [Agentic Bootcamp™ (PT-BR)](https://hsnlabs.ai/bootcamp/): Validamos a arquitetura nos seus sistemas e entregamos o Business Case antes de escalar, com US$ 5.000 em créditos de nuvem, tokens de IA e ferramentas.
- [Agentic Bootcamp™ (EN)](https://hsnlabs.ai/en/bootcamp/): We embed senior engineering leadership inside your operation to validate data access, map executable business ontologies, deploy a sandbox prototype on LangGraph, and deliver an audited production Business Case.
- [Bootcamp Markdown Mirror (PT-BR)](https://hsnlabs.ai/bootcamp/index.md): Machine-readable specification of the Agentic Bootcamp in Portuguese.
- [Bootcamp Markdown Mirror (EN)](https://hsnlabs.ai/en/bootcamp/index.md): Machine-readable specification of the Agentic Bootcamp in English.

## Ecosystem & Platform Alliances
- [LangChain & LangGraph Architecture (PT-BR)](https://hsnlabs.ai/langchain/): Orquestração StateGraph, LangSmith evals e runtimes soberanos em VPC.
- [LangChain & LangGraph Architecture (EN)](https://hsnlabs.ai/en/langchain/): Independent agentic engineering with LangChain and LangGraph in production since 2022.
- [Snowflake AI Data Cloud Architecture (PT-BR)](https://hsnlabs.ai/snowflake/): Máquinas de estado determinísticas e ontologias executáveis sobre Snowflake AI Data Cloud.
- [Snowflake AI Data Cloud Architecture (EN)](https://hsnlabs.ai/en/snowflake/): Operationalizing deterministic LangGraph state machines over the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.
- [Databricks Lakehouse Architecture (PT-BR)](https://hsnlabs.ai/databricks/): Agentes autônomos sobre Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, Delta Lake e Unity Catalog.
- [Databricks Lakehouse Architecture (EN)](https://hsnlabs.ai/en/databricks/): Operationalizing deterministic LangGraph state machines over Databricks and Mosaic AI.
- [Braintrust Evals & CI/CD (PT-BR)](https://hsnlabs.ai/braintrust/): Suítes de avaliação contínua, gates de regressão em CI/CD e observabilidade de traces.
- [Braintrust Evals & CI/CD (EN)](https://hsnlabs.ai/en/braintrust/): Eliminating stochastic prompt regressions in production with Braintrust continuous evaluation suites.
- [Enterprise MCP Servers (PT-BR)](https://hsnlabs.ai/mcp/): Servidores Model Context Protocol privados conectando agentes a SAP, TOTVS e bancos relacionais.
- [Enterprise MCP Servers (EN)](https://hsnlabs.ai/en/mcp/): Private, zero-trust Model Context Protocol servers inside your cloud perimeter.
